description.narrative: IFC expects the Project will provide equity to TCB to complement a previous project (Project #47422) with the Bank, where IFC granted a senior loan, in supporting increased access to finance to underserved MSMEs, including WMSMEs. IFCs systematic social-themed financing will contribute to catalyzing the market by promoting deeper competitiveness in the MSME finance market by demonstrating the viability of a differentiated MSME strategy and stimulating other players to replicate.

The proposed project entails IFCs equity investment of up to US$30 million equivalent in Thai baht as a cornerstone investor in an Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Thai Credit Bank Public Company Limited (TCB or the Bank) (The Project). The Bank is the only Thai bank that focuses on underserved segment in Thailand. The Bank targets the micro and SMEs which represent 34.6% of Thai 2021 GDP and 71.9% of total workforce. Total equity stake to be offered at the IPO will be up to 28.2% stake post IPO, including 5.2% new shares and 23.0% secondary shares. The Project will be a continuation of IFCs systematic efforts to promote financial inclusion in Thailand and signal confidence in TCBs inclusive business model. IFCs cornerstone participation in the IPO is expected to crowd in other investors to further support the Banks strategy focusing on MSMEs, digitalization and sustainable finance.
